title: “Bo‘lmoq” fe’li va eng oddiy gaplar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida am, is, are fe’lini ega olmoshlari bilan to‘g‘ri ishlatasiz, oddiy darak, inkor va so‘roq gaplar tuzasiz hamda Yes, I am / No, he isn’t kabi qisqa javob berasiz.

scenes.title: Beshinchi darsga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Beshinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda o‘zingiz, oilangiz va qarindoshlaringiz haqida so‘z o‘rgandik. Endi o‘sha so‘zlarni gapga aylantirish vaqti keldi. Bugun ingliz tilidagi eng muhim fe’l — “to be” bilan tanishamiz. Dars oxirida o‘zingiz va boshqa odamlar haqida to‘g‘ri, oddiy gaplar tuza olasiz, savol berasiz va qisqa javob qaytarasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome! Today we learn the most important verb in English: to be.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz! Bugun ingliz tilidagi eng muhim fe’lni o‘rganamiz: to be.

scenes.title: Nega bu fe’l kerak?
board: Men talabaman. → I am a student.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida “Men talabaman” deymiz. Bu yerda alohida fe’l yo‘q: “-man” qo‘shimchasi o‘zi gapni tugatadi. Ingliz tilida bunday qo‘shimcha yo‘q. Shuning uchun “I student” deb bo‘lmaydi. Gapni bog‘lab turuvchi alohida so‘z kerak: “I am a student”. Mana shu “am”, “is”, “are” so‘zlari “to be” fe’lining shakllari. Ular “ega” bilan “kim yoki qanday” degan qismni bog‘laydi.
scenes.say: In Uzbek the ending does the job. In English we need a separate word: am, is or are.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zbek tilida qo‘shimcha shu ishni qiladi. Ingliz tilida alohida so‘z kerak: am, is yoki are.

scenes.title: Ega olmoshlari: I, you, he, she
scenes.say_native: Avval ega olmoshlarini bilib olamiz. “I” — men. Bu olmosh gapning o‘rtasida ham doim bosh harf bilan yoziladi. “You” — sen yoki siz. “He” — u, agar gap erkak haqida bo‘lsa. “She” — u, agar gap ayol haqida bo‘lsa. O‘zbek tilida “u” bitta, ingliz tilida esa odamning jinsiga qarab ikkiga bo‘linadi. Buni e’tiborda tuting.
scenes.say: I, you, he, she. I am Aziz. She is a doctor.
scenes.say_uz: Men, sen yoki siz, u, u. Men Azizman. U shifokor.

scenes.title: It, we, they
scenes.say_native: Yana uchta olmosh bor. “It” — narsa, hayvon yoki tushuncha uchun: kitob, stol, mushuk. Ingliz tilida narsani “he” yoki “she” deb bo‘lmaydi. “We” — biz. “They” — ular, ham odamlar, ham narsalar uchun. Mana, hammasi: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. Yettita kichik so‘z, lekin ingliz tilidagi deyarli har bir gap shulardan biri bilan boshlanishi mumkin.
scenes.say: It is a book. We are students. They are friends.
scenes.say_uz: Bu kitob. Biz talabamiz. Ular do‘stlar.

scenes.title: You — bitta ham, ko‘p ham
scenes.say_native: O‘zbekcha “sen” va “siz” ni farqlaymiz, hurmat uchun “siz” deymiz. Inglizcha “you” esa bittagina: do‘stingizga ham, direktorga ham, bir kishiga ham, ko‘p kishiga ham “you” deyiladi. Hurmat boshqa so‘zlar va ohang bilan beriladi. Ikkinchi xato: “I” ni kichik harf bilan yozish. Ingliz tilida “I” har doim katta harf. Bu kichik narsa, lekin xat yozganda darrov ko‘zga tashlanadi.
scenes.say: You is one word for one person or many people. And I is always a capital letter.
scenes.say_uz: You bir kishi uchun ham, ko‘p kishi uchun ham bitta so‘z. I esa har doim bosh harf.

scenes.title: Qaysi olmosh?
scenes.say_native: Beshta ega berilgan. Har biri uchun mos olmoshni ayting: Anna, Tom, stol, “Anna va men”, “Tom va Ben”. Eslatma: Anna ayol, Tom erkak, stol esa narsa. Shoshilmang: har bir ega uchun olmoshni avval ichingizda ayting, keyin ovoz chiqarib takrorlang. Javobni darrov keyingi sahnada tekshiramiz.
scenes.say: Anna? Tom? The table? Anna and I? Tom and Ben?
scenes.say_uz: Anna? Tom? Stol? Anna va men? Tom va Ben?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Anna — “she”. Tom — “he”. Stol — “it”. “Anna va men” — bizlar, ya’ni “we”. “Tom va Ben” — ular, ya’ni “they”. Agar siz “Anna and I” uchun “they” desangiz, o‘zingizni ham hisobga olmadingiz. Gapda o‘zingiz bo‘lsangiz, har doim “we” bo‘ladi. Bu olmoshlar gapning boshida turadi va fe’lning shaklini aynan ular belgilaydi, shuning uchun ularni hozir puxta o‘rganing.
scenes.say: Anna is she. Tom is he. The table is it. Anna and I are we. Tom and Ben are they.
scenes.say_uz: Anna — she. Tom — he. Stol — it. Anna va men — we. Tom va Ben — they.

scenes.title: Am: faqat I bilan
scenes.say_native: Endi fe’lning uchta shakli. Birinchisi — “am”. U faqat “I” bilan ishlatiladi, boshqa hech qaysi olmosh bilan emas. “I am a teacher” — men o‘qituvchiman. “I am from Samarkand” — men Samarqandlikman. Bu xuddi o‘zbekcha “-man” qo‘shimchasi. Ikkinchi va uchinchi shaxs uchun boshqa shakllar kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: I am a teacher. I am from Samarkand.
scenes.say_uz: Men o‘qituvchiman. Men Samarqandlikman.

scenes.title: Is: he, she, it
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi shakl — “is”. U bir kishi yoki bitta narsa haqida gapirganda, ya’ni “he”, “she” va “it” bilan ishlatiladi. “He is my brother” — u mening akam. “She is a nurse” — u hamshira. “It is cold” — sovuq. Bir narsani eslab qoling: “is” faqat bitta ega uchun. Ega ko‘p bo‘lsa, boshqa shakl kerak.
scenes.say: He is my brother. She is a nurse. It is cold.
scenes.say_uz: U mening akam. U hamshira. Sovuq.

scenes.title: Are: you, we, they
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi shakl — “are”. U “you”, “we” va “they” bilan ishlatiladi. “You are late” — siz kechikdingiz. “We are friends” — biz do‘stmiz. “They are at home” — ular uyda. Diqqat: “you” bir kishi bo‘lsa ham “are” ishlatiladi, “you is” deyish xato. Endi uchala shaklni bitta jadvalda ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: You are late. We are friends. They are at home.
scenes.say_uz: Siz kechikdingiz. Biz do‘stmiz. Ular uyda.

scenes.title: To be: to‘liq jadval
scenes.say_native: Mana butun jadval. I am. You are. He is, she is, it is. We are. They are. Oltita ega, uchta shakl: am, is, are. Bu fe’lning shakllari hamma fe’llar ichida eng tartibsizi, shuning uchun uni yodlab olish kerak. Lekin yaxshi xabar bor: bu jadvalni bir marta puxta o‘rgansangiz, boshqa deyarli hamma gaplarda ishlatasiz.
scenes.say: I am. You are. He is. She is. It is. We are. They are.
scenes.say_uz: I am. You are. He is. She is. It is. We are. They are.

scenes.title: Am, is yoki are?
scenes.say_native: Beshta gap. Bo‘sh joyga “am”, “is” yoki “are” ni qo‘ying va butun gapni baland ovozda ayting. Avval egani toping, keyin shaklni tanlang. Egani toping, jadvaldan mos shaklni tanlang va butun gapni to‘liq ayting. Avval o‘zingiz urinib ko‘ring, keyin javobni tinglang.
scenes.say: I blank happy. She blank a doctor. We blank students. It blank big. They blank here.
scenes.say_uz: Men blank xursand. U blank shifokor. Biz blank talabamiz. U blank katta. Ular blank shu yerda.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Tekshiramiz. Birinchi: “I am happy”. Ikkinchi: “She is a doctor”. Uchinchi: “We are students”. To‘rtinchi: “It is big”. Beshinchi: “They are here”. Agar hammasini to‘g‘ri aytgan bo‘lsangiz, zo‘r. Xato qilgan bo‘lsangiz, jadvalga qaytib, ega bilan fe’lni yana bir bor juftlab chiqing.
scenes.say: I am happy. She is a doctor. We are students. It is big. They are here.
scenes.say_uz: Men xursandman. U shifokor. Biz talabamiz. U katta. Ular shu yerda.

scenes.title: Qisqa shakllar
board: he is → he’s · she is → she’s
we are → we’re · they are → they’re
scenes.say_native: Og‘zaki nutqda ingliz tilida odamlar deyarli doim qisqa shakldan foydalanadi. “I am” o‘rniga “I’m”, “you are” o‘rniga “you’re”, “he is” o‘rniga “he’s”, “she’s”, “it’s”, “we’re”, “they’re”. Apostrof tushib qolgan harfning o‘rnini bildiradi. Yozma ish yoki rasmiy matnda to‘liq shakl ham bo‘ladi, lekin suhbatda qisqa shakl tabiiyroq.
scenes.say: I'm Aziz. He's my friend. We're at home.
scenes.say_uz: Men Azizman. U mening do‘stim. Biz uydamiz.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: qisqa shakllar
scenes.say_native: Talaffuz haqida. “I’m” — “ayim” tarzida, bitta cho‘ziq tovush bilan. “He’s” — “xiz”, oxirida “z” tovushi. “She’s” — “shiz”. Qiziq tomoni: “they’re” inglizcha “there” bilan bir xil eshitiladi, “you’re” esa “your” bilan o‘xshash. Shuning uchun eshitganda ma’noga qarab tushunasiz. Takrorlaymiz: I’m, he’s, she’s, they’re.
scenes.say: I'm. He's. She's. They're. You're.
scenes.say_uz: I'm. He's. She's. They're. You're.

scenes.title: Takrorlang
scenes.say_native: Endi takrorlang. Har bir gapni men aytganimdan keyin ovoz chiqarib ayting. Qisqa shakllarni bir-biriga yopishtirib, tez va yengil aytishga harakat qiling. Mashq paytida ovozingizni yozib olib, keyin tinglab ko‘rsangiz, o‘zingizning xatolaringizni darrov eshitasiz. Bu juda foydali odat.
scenes.say: I'm a student. She's a teacher. We're friends.
scenes.say_uz: Men talabaman. U o‘qituvchi. Biz do‘stmiz.

scenes.title: A va an
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida artikl yo‘q, ingliz tilida esa bor. Birlikdagi sanaladigan ot oldida “a” yoki “an” qo‘yiladi. “I am a student”, “She is a nurse”. Agar so‘z unli tovush bilan boshlansa, “an” kerak: “an engineer”, “an apple”. Muhimi harf emas, tovush. Hozircha shuni bilsangiz kifoya, artikllarni keyingi darslarda yana ko‘p mashq qilamiz.
scenes.say: She is a nurse. He is an engineer.
scenes.say_uz: U hamshira. U muhandis.

scenes.title: Fe’lni tushirib qoldirish
scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan xato — fe’lni tushirib qoldirish. O‘zbek tilida “Men talabaman” deymiz va ketdik, shuning uchun inglizchada ham “I student” degingiz keladi. Bu xato. Ikkinchi xato — artiklni tushirib qoldirish: “I am student”. To‘g‘ri variant: “I am a student”. Gap tuzayotganda uchta narsani tekshiring: ega, am-is-are, va kerak bo‘lsa a yoki an.
scenes.say: I am a student. She is a teacher. Do not drop the verb.
scenes.say_uz: Men talabaman. U o‘qituvchi. Fe’lni tashlab ketmang.

scenes.title: O‘zbekchadan inglizchaga
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta o‘zbekcha gapni inglizchaga o‘giring. Birinchisi: “Men talabaman”. Ikkinchisi: erkak o‘qituvchi haqida. Uchinchisi: “Biz uydamiz”, “uyda” — “at home”. To‘rtinchisi: “Ular xursand”, “xursand” — “happy”. Har birini to‘liq gap qilib ayting. Shoshilmang, har bir gapni o‘ylab ayting. Eng muhimi, fe’lni tushirib qoldirmaslik.
scenes.say: I am a student. He is a teacher. We are at home. They are happy.
scenes.say_uz: Men talabaman. U o‘qituvchi. Biz uydamiz. Ular xursand.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “I am a student”. “He is a teacher”. “We are at home”. “They are happy”. E’tibor bering: o‘zbekcha gapda qo‘shimcha edi, inglizchada uning o‘rniga alohida so‘z turibdi. Uchinchi gapda “at home” — “uyda”. “At” o‘zbekcha “-da” qo‘shimchasiga to‘g‘ri keladi, lekin inglizchada u oldin keladi. Bu haqida keyingi darslarda ko‘proq gaplashamiz.
scenes.say: I am a student. He is a teacher. We are at home. They are happy.
scenes.say_uz: Men talabaman. U o‘qituvchi. Biz uydamiz. Ular xursand.

scenes.title: Holat: be + sifat
scenes.say_native: Inglizcha “to be” bilan holatni ham aytamiz. “I’m tired” — charchadim. “He’s hungry” — u och. “We’re busy” — biz bandmiz. “It’s hot” — issiq. O‘zbek tilida bunday holatlar ko‘pincha o‘zgacha fe’l bilan keladi: charchadim, ochman. Inglizchada esa doim “am, is, are” va undan keyin holatni bildiruvchi so‘z. Mana shu sifatlarni o‘zingizga yodlab oling: tired, hungry, busy, hot, cold, happy.
scenes.say: I'm tired. He's hungry. We're busy. It's hot.
scenes.say_uz: Men charchadim. U och. Biz bandmiz. Issiq.

scenes.title: Joy: be + joy
scenes.say_native: “To be” joyni ham bildiradi. “I’m at home” — men uydaman. “She’s at work” — u ishda. “We’re in Tashkent” — biz Toshkentdamiz. “They’re at school” — ular maktabda. O‘zbek tilida joy uchun “-da” qo‘shimchasi yetadi. Inglizchada esa “at” yoki “in” kerak. Hozircha shunday eslang: uy, ish, maktab bilan “at”, shahar yoki mamlakat bilan “in”.
scenes.say: I'm at home. She's at work. We're in Tashkent.
scenes.say_uz: Men uydaman. U ishda. Biz Toshkentdamiz.

scenes.title: Am, is, are aralashib ketmasin
board: ✓ I am · He is · They are
scenes.say_native: Boshlovchilar ko‘pincha shakllarni almashtirib yuboradi. “I is happy” — xato, chunki “I” faqat “am” bilan. “He are a doctor” — xato, “he” bilan “is” kerak. “They is at home” — xato, “they” bilan “are”. Kalit qoida shu: “I” — am, bir kishi yoki bitta narsa — is, “you”, “we”, “they” — are. Agar gapirayotganda adashsangiz, to‘xtab jadvalni xayolan ko‘z oldingizga keltiring.
scenes.say: I am, he is, they are. Never I is, he are or they is.
scenes.say_uz: I am, he is, they are. Hech qachon I is, he are yoki they is emas.

scenes.title: Xatoni toping
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapda xato bor. Har birini to‘g‘rilab, qaytadan ayting. Avval egani toping: I, she, they, we. Keyin unga mos fe’lni qo‘ying. Bu mashqda adashish normal, chunki xatoni topa olish o‘rganishning eng yaxshi usullaridan biri. Har bir gapni ikki marta ayting: avval xatosini, keyin to‘g‘ri variantini.
scenes.say: I is happy. She are a doctor. They is at home. We am friends.
scenes.say_uz: I is happy. She are a doctor. They is at home. We am friends.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri variantlar: “I am happy”. “She is a doctor”. “They are at home”. “We are friends”. Xatolarning hammasi egani va fe’lni juftlashdagi chalkashlik edi. Shuning uchun har gapda bir soniya to‘xtab o‘ylang: kim haqida gapiryapman, unga qaysi shakl to‘g‘ri keladi?
scenes.say: I am happy. She is a doctor. They are at home. We are friends.
scenes.say_uz: Men xursandman. U shifokor. Ular uyda. Biz do‘stmiz.

scenes.title: Inkor: not
board: he is not = he isn’t / he’s not
you are not = you aren’t / you’re not
scenes.say_native: Inkor gap juda oson: fe’ldan keyin “not” qo‘shamiz. O‘zbekchadagi “emasman”, “emas” ning o‘rnini shu “not” bosadi. “I am not a doctor” — men shifokor emasman. Qisqa shakllar: “is not” — “isn’t”, “are not” — “aren’t”. Yoki “she’s not”, “we’re not”. Ikkalasi ham to‘g‘ri. Faqat “I” bilan bitta shakl bor: “I’m not”. “I amn’t” deb aytilmaydi.
scenes.say: I'm not a doctor. She isn't at home. We aren't tired.
scenes.say_uz: Men shifokor emasman. U uyda emas. Biz charchagan emasmiz.

scenes.title: Inkorda xatolar
board: ✓ I’m not a teacher. He isn’t here.
scenes.say_native: Inkorda uchta xato uchraydi. Birinchisi: “no” ishlatish. “I no am” — xato, “not” kerak. Ikkinchisi: so‘z tartibi. “He not is here” emas, “He is not here”: avval fe’l, keyin “not”. Uchinchisi: “amn’t”. Bunday shakl yo‘q, “I’m not” deymiz. Esda qoling: ega, fe’l, not, keyin qolgani. O‘zbekchada inkor oxirda keladi, inglizchada fe’ldan keyin turadi.
scenes.say: I'm not a teacher. He is not here. There is no amn't.
scenes.say_uz: Men o‘qituvchi emasman. U bu yerda emas. Amn't degan shakl yo‘q.

scenes.title: Inkor gap tuzing
scenes.say_native: Har bir gapni inkorga aylantiring. Qisqa shaklni ishlatsangiz yaxshi. Birinchisi: “He is a doctor”. Ikkinchisi: “We are tired”. Uchinchisi: “I am late”. To‘rtinchisi: “They are at home”. Uchinchi gapda diqqat: “I” bilan faqat bitta variant bor. Qisqa shakl ishlatsangiz, gapingiz tabiiyroq eshitiladi. Shoshilmang va har bir gapni to‘liq ayting.
scenes.say: He is a doctor. We are tired. I am late. They are at home.
scenes.say_uz: U shifokor. Biz charchadik. Men kechikdim. Ular uyda.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “He isn’t a doctor”. “We aren’t tired”. “I’m not late”. “They aren’t at home”. Yana bir foydali narsa: “He’s not a doctor” ham to‘g‘ri. Ikkala usulni ham eshitasiz, ikkalasi ham tabiiy. Qaysi biri qulayroq bo‘lsa, shuni ishlating. Savol bilan inkorni adashtirmang: inkorda ega birinchi o‘rinda qoladi, fe’ldan keyin esa not keladi.
scenes.say: He isn't a doctor. We aren't tired. I'm not late. They aren't at home.
scenes.say_uz: U shifokor emas. Biz charchamadik. Men kechikmadim. Ular uyda emas.

scenes.title: Savol: o‘rin almashtirish
board: You are late. → Are you late?
He is here. → Is he here?
I am right. → Am I right?
scenes.say_native: Savol tuzish uchun fe’lni ega oldiga olib chiqamiz. “You are a student” — gap. “Are you a student?” — savol. “She is at home” — gap, “Is she at home?” — savol. O‘zbekchada savol uchun “-mi” yuklamasi qo‘shiladi: talabamisiz, uydami. Inglizchada esa so‘zlarning tartibi o‘zgaradi. Ovoz oxirida ko‘tariladi. Bu ham ohangdagi farq.
scenes.say: Are you a student? Is she at home? Am I late?
scenes.say_uz: Siz talabamisiz? U uydami? Men kechikdimmi?

scenes.title: Qisqa javob
board: Are you tired? — Yes, I am. / No, I’m not.
Is he here? — Yes, he is. / No, he isn’t.
Are they friends? — Yes, they are. / No, they aren’t.

examples.t: Is she a nurse? Yes, she is.
Are you hungry? No, I’m not.

scenes.say_native: Ha-yo‘q savoliga qisqa javob beramiz: “Yes” yoki “No”, keyin olmosh va fe’l. “Are you tired?” — “Yes, I am.” yoki “No, I’m not.” “Is he here?” — “Yes, he is.” yoki “No, he isn’t.” O‘zbekchada “ha” yoki “yo‘q” deb to‘xtash mumkin, inglizchada esa bu o‘ta qisqa va biroz qo‘pol eshitiladi. Shuning uchun qisqa javobni o‘rganing.
scenes.say: Are you tired? Yes, I am. Is he here? No, he isn't.
scenes.say_uz: Charchadingizmi? Ha. U shu yerdami? Yo‘q.

scenes.title: Qisqa javobdagi xatolar
board: ✓ Yes, I am. / Yes, he is.
✓ No, I’m not. / No, he isn’t.
scenes.say_native: Qisqa javobda bitta qoida bor: tasdiq javobda qisqartirish yo‘q. “Yes, I’m” — xato, “Yes, I am” deymiz. “Yes, he’s” ham xato, “Yes, he is”. Sababi shuki, qisqa javob oxirida fe’l urg‘u oladi. Inkorda esa qisqartirish mumkin: “No, I’m not”, “No, he isn’t”. Yana: savoldagi ismni olmosh bilan almashtiring. “Is Anna a nurse?” — “Yes, she is.”
scenes.say: Yes, I am. Yes, he is. No, I'm not. No, he isn't.
scenes.say_uz: Ha, shunday. Ha, shunday. Yo‘q. Yo‘q.

scenes.title: Savolga javob bering
board: 4) Are you a student of this course?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Har biriga to‘liq qisqa javob bering: “Yes” yoki “No”, olmosh, fe’l. Birinchi savol Toshkent haqida, ikkinchisi fillar haqida, uchinchisi London haqida, to‘rtinchisi o‘zingiz haqingizda. Qaysi olmosh kerakligini o‘ylang: shahar uchun “it”, fillar uchun “they”.
scenes.say: Is Tashkent in Uzbekistan? Are elephants small? Is London in France? Are you a student of this course?
scenes.say_uz: Toshkent O‘zbekistondami? Fillar kichikmi? London Fransiyadami? Siz bu kursning talabasimisiz?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Toshkent O‘zbekistondami? “Yes, it is.” Fillar kichikmi? “No, they aren’t.” London Fransiyadami? “No, it isn’t.” Siz bu kursning talabasimisiz? “Yes, I am.” Savolda “elephants” bor, shuning uchun javobda “they”. Shahar uchun esa “it”. Olmosh bu yerda ham ega o‘rnida turadi.
scenes.say: Yes, it is. No, they aren't. No, it isn't. Yes, I am.
scenes.say_uz: Ha. Yo‘q. Yo‘q. Ha.

scenes.title: Dialog: tanishuv
board: Maria: No, I’m not. I’m Maria. Anna is over there. She’s a teacher.
Tom: Thank you. I’m Tom. I’m a new student.
Maria: Welcome! We’re all friends here.
scenes.say_native: Endi birinchi tinglash dialogi. Til maktabida Tom Anna ismli o‘qituvchini qidiryapti. U Mariyadan so‘raydi. Tinglang, kim kim ekanini tushunishga harakat qiling. Dialogda bugungi barcha shakllar bor: am, is, are, inkor va savol. Keyin uchta savolga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Hello. Are you Anna? No, I'm not. I'm Maria. Anna is over there. She's a teacher. Thank you. I'm Tom. I'm a new student. Welcome! We're all friends here.
scenes.say_uz: Salom. Siz Annamisiz? Yo‘q. Men Mariyaman. Anna anavi yerda. U o‘qituvchi. Rahmat. Men Tomman. Men yangi talabaman. Xush kelibsiz! Bu yerda hamma do‘stmiz.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha uchta savol. Birinchi: Mariya Annamikan? Ikkinchi: Anna talabami? Uchinchi: Tom yangimi? Har birini qisqa javob bilan ayting. Dialogni yodingizda tutib, avval o‘zingizcha javobni ayting, keyin keyingi sahnada tekshiring. Qisqa javob ichida olmosh bo‘lishi kerakligini unutmang.
scenes.say: Is Maria Anna? Is Anna a student? Is Tom new?
scenes.say_uz: Mariya Annamikan? Anna talabami? Tom yangimi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) No, she isn’t. She’s a teacher.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Mariya Annamikan? “No, she isn’t.” U Mariya. Anna talabami? “No, she isn’t.” U o‘qituvchi. Tom yangimi? “Yes, he is.” U yangi talaba. Dialogda “Are you Anna?” ga Mariya “No, I’m not” deb javob berdi. Bu aynan bugungi inkor qisqa javob. Dialogda ishlatilgan har bir shakl bugungi qoidalarga to‘g‘ri keladi, shuning uchun uni o‘zingizga namuna qilib oling.
scenes.say: No, she isn't. No, she isn't. Yes, he is.
scenes.say_uz: Yo‘q. Yo‘q. Ha.

scenes.title: Dialog: telefonda
board: A: Hi, Aziz. Where are you?
Aziz: I’m at home. I’m tired.
A: Are Ali and Dilya with you?
Aziz: No, they aren’t. They’re at work.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog — telefonda. Do‘stlar bir-birining qayerdaligini so‘rayapti. Eshitasiz: “Where are you?” — siz qayerdasiz? Bu yangi savol, lekin tuzilishi oson: “Where” va keyin “are you”. Diqqat bilan tinglang: Aziz qayerda, u o‘zini qanday his qilyapti va Ali bilan Dilya qayerda.
scenes.say: Hi, Aziz. Where are you? I'm at home. I'm tired. Are Ali and Dilya with you? No, they aren't. They're at work.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, Aziz. Qayerdasan? Uydaman. Charchadim. Ali bilan Dilya sen bilanmi? Yo‘q. Ular ishda.

scenes.title: Savollar
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Aziz qayerda? U xursandmi? Ali va Dilya qayerda? Birinchi va uchinchi savolga “where” bilan to‘liq gap qilib, ikkinchisiga “yes” yoki “no” bilan qisqa javob bering. Shoshilmang, dialogni yodingizga keltiring va to‘liq gapda javob bering. Qisqa javob uchun ham olmosh kerakligini eslang.
scenes.say: Where is Aziz? Is he happy? Where are Ali and Dilya?
scenes.say_uz: Aziz qayerda? U xursandmi? Ali va Dilya qayerda?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Aziz qayerda? “He’s at home.” U uyda. U xursandmi? “No, he isn’t.” U charchagan, ya’ni “tired”. Ali va Dilya qayerda? “They’re at work.” Ular ishda. E’tibor bering, savolda ismlar bor edi, javobda esa olmoshlar: Aziz — he, Ali va Dilya — they.
scenes.say: He's at home. No, he isn't. He's tired. They're at work.
scenes.say_uz: U uyda. Yo‘q, u xursand emas. U charchagan. Ular ishda.

scenes.title: So‘roq so‘zlar: who, where, what
board: Who is he? — He’s my brother.
Where are you from? — I’m from Bukhara.
What is it? — It’s a book.
scenes.say_native: Ha-yo‘q savolidan boshqa savollar ham bor. “Who” — kim. “Where” — qayer. “What” — nima. Ularning hammasi bir xil tuzilishda: so‘roq so‘z, keyin “is” yoki “are”, keyin ega. “Who is she?” — u kim? “Where are you from?” — siz qayerliksiz? “What is it?” — bu nima? Javobda esa odatdagi gap beriladi. Qisqa va foydali iboralar.
scenes.say: Who is he? Where are you from? What is it?
scenes.say_uz: U kim? Siz qayerliksiz? Bu nima?

scenes.title: O‘zingiz haqingizda gapiring
scenes.say_native: Endi navbat sizda. Kamida to‘rtta gap ayting. Birinchisi: ismingiz. Ikkinchisi: qayerlik ekaningiz. Uchinchisi: hozir qanday holatdasiz. To‘rtinchisi: hozir qayerdasiz. Masalan: “I’m Aziz. I’m from Samarkand. I’m a bit tired. I’m at home.” O‘zingizning gaplaringizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Say four sentences about yourself. Your name, your city, how you feel and where you are.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zingiz haqingizda to‘rtta gap ayting: ismingiz, shahringiz, holatingiz va hozirgi joyingiz.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
scenes.say_native: Namuna. “I’m Aziz. I’m from Samarkand. I’m a little tired. I’m at home.” Sizniki boshqacha bo‘ladi, bu normal. Muhimi shu: har bir gapda ega va fe’l bor, “I’m” bilan boshlandi. Agar siz hammasini shunday bog‘lagan bo‘lsangiz, bugungi dars maqsadiga yetdingiz. Endi ularni yaxshi eslab qolish uchun yozma ravishda ham mashq qiling.
scenes.say: I'm Aziz. I'm from Samarkand. I'm a little tired. I'm at home.
scenes.say_uz: Men Azizman. Men Samarqandlikman. Biroz charchaganman. Men uydaman.

scenes.title: Qisqacha takrorlaymiz
board: I am · you are · he/she/it is · we are · they are
Javob: Yes, I am. / No, he isn’t.
scenes.say_native: Bugungi darsni qisqacha eslaymiz. Birinchi: o‘zbekcha qo‘shimcha o‘rnida inglizchada alohida fe’l kerak, to‘g‘ri: am, is, are. Ikkinchi: ega olmoshlari, I, you, he, she, it, we, they. Uchinchi: inkor uchun fe’ldan keyin “not”. To‘rtinchi: savolda fe’l oldinga chiqadi. Beshinchi: qisqa javob, “Yes, I am” va “No, he isn’t”. Shunday qilib, siz endi ingliz tilida eng oddiy gaplarni tuza olasiz.
scenes.say: Today you learned am, is, are, the seven pronouns, negatives, questions and short answers. Well done!
scenes.say_uz: Bugun siz am, is, are, yettita olmosh, inkor, savol va qisqa javoblarni o‘rgandingiz. Barakalla!

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: I am … / He is … / She is …
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi. Siz bilgan odamlar haqida sakkizta “I am” yoki “he is” tipidagi gap yozing. Masalan: “I am a student. My brother is tall. She is my friend.” Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir gapda ega, am, is yoki are bo‘lsin, kamida ikkitasi inkor bo‘lsin. Keyingi darsda kasblar va ish joylarini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Homework: write eight sentences about people you know. Use am, is and are correctly.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: tanish odamlar haqida sakkizta gap yozing. Am, is va are ni to‘g‘ri ishlating.

homework_uz: Siz bilgan odamlar haqida sakkizta “I am / he is” tipidagi gap yozing (masalan: I am a student. My brother is tall.). Har bir gapda ega va am, is yoki are bo‘lsin, kamida ikkitasi inkor bo‘lsin.

quiz.why_uz: She bilan is ishlatiladi: She is a doctor.
Inglizchada fe’l va artikl kerak: I am a student.

quiz.q: Which pronoun is for a table?
Make it negative: He is tired.
quiz.why_uz: Is dan keyin not: He is not tired yoki He isn’t tired.

quiz.q: Are you a teacher? Short answer: yes.
quiz.why_uz: Tasdiq qisqa javobda qisqartirish yo‘q: Yes, I am.

quiz.q: Is Anna your sister? Short answer: no.
quiz.why_uz: Anna ayol, shuning uchun she, fe’l is: No, she isn’t.
Savolda fe’l ega oldiga chiqadi: Are you late?
London Fransiyada emas. Shahar uchun it: No, it isn’t.
